fullPassage: "Tactics" is a term drawn from military usage. Strategies are plans of action directing a military force when attacking another, and tactics are responses to conditions on the ground. In this vein, time is imposed on us by our cultures, by the technologies that have regimented time down to the nanosecond, and by its own finite nature and the fact that we're going to live only so long. In response, we must develop tactics for dealing with time and waiting. These aren't tactics to eliminate waiting; instead, these are tactics for teaching us how to learn from the seams. These tactics have the potential to reorient us in profound ways, transforming our perspectives on our wait times. Such renewed perspectives transform waiting from a burden to a springboard toward things like creativity, social critique, or reflection on our inner state and the state of our relationships.

det.korean: (A) drawn = 끌어온 (B) imposed = 부과된 (C) eliminate = 제거하다

❌ ② removed는 drawn(끌어온)의 반의어
❌ ③ released는 imposed(부과된)의 반의어
❌ ④ preserve는 eliminate(제거하다)의 반의어
det.tip: draw from = ~에서 끌어오다, impose = 부과하다, eliminate = 제거하다

questions.passage: In this vein, time is imposed on us by our cultures, by the technologies that have __________ (regiment) time down to the nanosecond, and by its own finite nature.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 이러한 맥락에서, 시간은 우리의 문화에 의해, 시간을 나노초 단위까지 엄격히 통제해 온 기술에 의해, 그리고 시간 자체의 유한한 본질에 의해 우리에게 부과된다.
det.analysis: regiment → regimented: have + 과거분사(p.p.) 구조인 현재완료형. have regimented = 엄격히 통제해 왔다.

questions.passage: "Tactics" is a term drawn from military usage. Strategies are plans of action directing a military force when attacking another, and tactics are responses to conditions on the ground. In this vein, time is imposed on us by our cultures, by the technologies that have regimented time down to the nanosecond, and by its own finite nature and the fact that we're going to live only so long. In response, we must develop tactics for __________. These aren't tactics to eliminate waiting; instead, these are tactics for teaching us how to learn from the seams. These tactics have the potential to reorient us in profound ways, transforming our perspectives on our wait times. Such renewed perspectives transform waiting from a burden to a springboard toward things like creativity, social critique, or reflection on our inner state and the state of our relationships.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 우리는 시간과 기다림을 (다루기) 위한 전술을 개발해야 한다
det.analysis:
❌ ① attacking another force: '다른 군대를 공격하는 것'은 전략의 설명이지 우리가 개발할 전술이 아님
✅ ② dealing with time and waiting: 시간과 기다림을 '다루기' 위한 전술을 개발해야 한다는 문맥에 적절 ←정답
❌ ③ plans of action: '행동 계획'은 전략의 정의
❌ ④ conditions on the ground: '현장 조건'은 전술이 반응하는 대상이지 전술의 목적이 아님
det.tip: develop tactics for dealing with ~ = ~을 다루기 위한 전술을 개발하다

questions.passage: "Tactics" is a term drawn from military usage. Strategies are plans of action directing a military force when attacking another, and tactics are responses to conditions on the ground. In this vein, time is imposed on us by our cultures, by the technologies that have regimented time down to the nanosecond, and by its own finite nature and the fact that we're going to live only so long. In response, we must develop tactics for dealing with time and waiting. These aren't tactics to eliminate waiting; instead, these are tactics for teaching us how to learn from the seams. These tactics have the potential to reorient us in profound ways, transforming our perspectives on our wait times. Such renewed perspectives transform waiting from a burden to a springboard toward things like creativity, social critique, or reflection on __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 창의성, 사회적 비평, 또는 (우리의 내적 상태와 관계의 상태)에 대한 성찰
det.analysis:
❌ ① plans of action directing a military force: 군사 전략 관련 표현으로 성찰 대상과 무관
❌ ② technologies that have regimented time: 시간을 통제한 기술로 성찰 대상이 아님
❌ ③ the potential to reorient us: 전술의 잠재력으로 성찰 대상이 아님
✅ ④ our inner state and the state of our relationships: 성찰의 대상으로 '우리의 내적 상태와 관계의 상태'가 문맥에 적절 ←정답
